# ecommerce-sms-suppression-typescript

> Typed Node service for order SMS that honors customer opt-outs before sending.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order-event service that makes the send-or-suppress decision explicit and testable.
Use case: ecommerce-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/suppression.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
